style: 16:9 cinematic photoreal Korean fictional horror. Teal shadows, warm fluorescent lights, readable dim details, restrained grain. No gore, text, brands or watermark. Consistent middle-aged Korean ghost, straight shoulder-length black hair tucked behind ears, burgundy blazer, black skirt, pearl brooch, left eyebrow scar, pale bare feet. Narrator face hidden.
